issue.title: Repair stale docs README contract-table SHA256 test after schema 16
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-hn.6.1.4 note #1. On clean bob-cli 3fe50bc75ef4b6c7ef35d878b4f881b7df1d2128, uv run --project tools/docs python -m pytest tools/docs/tests/test_contracts.py::test_readme_table_matches_original_contract_index_snapshot -q fails: actual 96a429d5f5b7eb02484e4806dac0ca688e41858e3187dfbdb26ad994a6107e4a, expected fedc20a035e78ecfd201ce2462d2eccb1683046f66c749477949287aade4fe72. Commit 81e0d0c2 (closed bob-cli-ho) legitimately changed the generated freshness contract row from JSON schema 15 to 16 but left the frozen table digest. Read docs memory before changes. Replace the obsolete migration snapshot assertion with a meaningful current registry/generated-table invariant, or deliberately update its baseline while explaining why a fixed hash is still useful; preserve existing generated-drift coverage. Run the focused contracts suite and docs gate. This is independent of the successor verdict feature.
